metadata.analyst_directive: Traffic-led (analyst Phase 0 decision): capture the proven character/licensed-cake quick-wins, CLOSE the dietary-USP gap (the brand's plant-based identity ranks page 3-6), and own the Melbourne category heads (Q13). Conversions poor + client ranks well -> quick-wins prioritised.

strategic_narratives.title: Brand identity vs organic traffic mismatch is the core opportunity
strategic_narratives.summary: The Cake People is positioned as award-winning 100% plant-based/allergen-friendly, but its organic engine is character/licensed cakes + milestone collections. Its dietary-USP terms rank page 3-6 (gluten free cakes melbourne #38/880mo, vegan cakes melbourne #28/720mo) despite existing collection pages. Closing that gap (Silo 3) aligns traffic with brand and is the highest-equity play; the character quick-wins (Silo 1) fund near-term conversion recovery the BDM asked for.

strategic_narratives.title: Quick-win density is exceptional — optimisation, not new content
strategic_narratives.summary: ~13 of 30 keywords sit GSC position 4-15 with hundreds-to-thousands of impressions on existing pages (kpop demon hunters #4.1/3552imp, barbie #6.9/3941imp, minecraft #12.1/2566imp). The dominant action is on-page optimisation of existing collection/product pages, so results should land inside the 1-3 month window — directly addressing 'conversions are poor, improve SEO'.

strategic_narratives.title: Two genuine new-build gaps: cake delivery + custom cakes Melbourne
strategic_narratives.summary: cake delivery melbourne (1,900/mo) and custom cakes melbourne (1,000/mo) are high-intent heads with no dedicated optimised landing page — currently ceded to Cheesecake Shop / Brunetti. The client genuinely competes (Melbourne-wide delivery + same-day Click & Collect + bespoke design) and should build dedicated hubs.
